title: Polyglot Teachers: Evaluating Language Models for Multilingual Synthetic Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.11290v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Synthesizing supervised finetuning (SFT) data from language models (LMs) to teach smaller models multilingual tasks has become increasingly common. However, teacher model selection is often ad hoc, typically defaulting to the largest available option, even though such models may have significant capability gaps in non-English languages. This practice can result in poor-quality synthetic data and suboptimal student downstream performance. In this work, we systematically characterize what makes an effective multilingual teacher. We combine intrinsic measures of data quality with extrinsic student model performance in a metric we call Polyglot Score. We evaluate 10 LMs across 6 typologically diverse languages, generating over 1.4M SFT examples and training 240 student models. translated_title: 多语教师：评估语言模型用于多语言合成数据生成的能力
translated_abstract: 利用语言模型（LM）合成监督微调（SFT）数据来教会更小的模型完成多语言任务的做法已日益普遍。然而，教师模型的选择往往是临时的，通常默认选择规模最大的可用模型，尽管这类模型在非英语语言上可能存在显著的能力差距。这种做法可能导致合成数据质量低下，学生模型的下游性能欠佳。在本工作中，我们系统地刻画了什么因素造就一个有效的多语言教师。我们将数据质量的内在度量与学生模型的外在性能相结合，提出了一个名为 Polyglot Score（多语得分）的指标。我们评估了 10 个语言模型，涵盖 6 种类型学上多样化的语言，生成了超过 140 万条 SFT 样本，并训练了 240 个学生模型。我们的分析表明，模型规模本身并不能显著预测教师模型的有效性：我们识别出的最有效的教师模型始终是较小的模型。
tldr: 本文提出 Polyglot Score 指标，通过评估 10 个语言模型在 6 种语言上生成超过 140 万条 SFT 数据并训练 240 个学生模型，发现模型规模并不能预测多语言教师模型的有效性，较小的模型反而往往是更有效的多语言教师。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Polyglot Score metric and, by evaluating 10 LMs across 6 typologically diverse languages with over 1.4M generated SFT examples and 240 trained student models, shows that model scale alone does not predict multilingual teacher effectiveness, with smaller models consistently emerging as the most effective teachers.
